purpose: Describe the absence of a normally expected thing or step.
keywords: N + なしに / なしで; V dictionary + ことなしに
Can I enter without a reservation?
Do not use the photo without permission.
I read this letter without a dictionary.
formation: N + なしに / なしで; V dictionary + ことなしに
restrictions: The noun may be permission, help, notice, or a resource.
mistake: Use なくしては for a strongly indispensable condition.
